audience: inventory and sales teams using SalesBinder

useCases.title: Find inventory across warehouses
useCases.text: Search inventory by SKU or barcode, choose a warehouse, and review its stock totals separately from account-level quantities. Open an item summary for a closer look.

useCases.title: Check customer account summaries
useCases.text: Find a customer by name, office email or customer number, then read the visible contact and account summary before a sales follow-up.

useCases.title: Review invoices for a customer
useCases.text: Find a customer and filter a page of invoices by date or status to review billed amounts and document status. Follow additional pages when needed.

useCases.title: Track sales-order fulfillment progress
useCases.text: Inspect invoiced, packed and shipped progress on a page of sales orders. Narrow the search by customer, status or warehouse to identify records needing follow-up.
